race.description: Muswellbrook & District Workers Club Mdn Plate
race.comment: CRUNCH (5) found some better standard maidens in his first campaign but this suits more. Has trialled twice in town and has been gelded now. Will not take much to see him lift substantially. Stable does bring horses to the country to find a winner. RETRIEVER (8) brings in plenty of trial experience. Should be hitting the line. REYLEGADO (2) was solid in two Victorian starts at the maiden campaign and has switched to Wayne Wilkes since. Readied with a nice trial so could measure up. CECIL PEAK (12) is open to improvement on a solid debut and draws for a soft run.
